69035-the-public-square.title: Public Square
69035-the-public-square.creator: Will Levington Comfort
69035-the-public-square.description: A book by Will Levington Comfort. A GIRL of nineteen had just arrived in New York, with one fat bag. She turned into the curving silence of Harrow Street, which is only three minutes’ walk from Washington Square, but some trick to find. Several times she changed her bag from one hand to the other, sometimes putting it down and stepping around it, until she came to a door with a room-to-rent sign.

arxiv-1810-01053.title: Decentralized Accelerated Gradient Methods With Increasing Penalty Parameters
arxiv-1810-01053.creator: Huan Li, Cong Fang, Wotao Yin, Zhouchen Lin
arxiv-1810-01053.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Huan Li, Cong Fang, Wotao Yin, Zhouchen Lin. In this paper, we study the communication and (sub)gradient computation costs in distributed optimization. We present two algorithms based on the framework of the accelerated penalty method with increasing penalty parameters.

arxiv-2007-00895.title: Black holes as clouded mirrors: the Hayden-Preskill protocol with symmetry
arxiv-2007-00895.creator: Yoshifumi Nakata, Eyuri Wakakuwa, Masato Koashi
arxiv-2007-00895.description: Abstract The Hayden-Preskill protocol is a qubit-toy model of the black hole information paradox. Based on the assumption of scrambling, it was revealed that quantum information is instantly leaked out from the quantum many-body system that models a black hole.

arxiv-2206-05244.title: The viability of ultralight bosonic dark matter in dwarf galaxies
arxiv-2206-05244.creator: Isabelle S. Goldstein, Savvas M. Koushiappas, Matthew G. Walker
arxiv-2206-05244.description: Abstract The dark matter distribution in dwarf galaxies holds a wealth of information on the fundamental properties and interactions of the dark matter particle. In this paper, we study whether ultralight bosonic dark matter is consistent with the gravitational potential extracted from stellar kinematics. We use velocity dispersion measurements to constrain models for halo mass and particle mass.

arxiv-2209-10483.title: Far-off-equilibrium expansion trajectories in the QCD phase diagram
arxiv-2209-10483.creator: Chandrodoy Chattopadhyay, Ulrich Heinz, Thomas Schäfer
arxiv-2209-10483.description: Abstract We consider the hydrodynamic evolution of a quark-gluon gas with non-zero quark masses and net baryon number in its phase diagram. For far-off-equilibrium initial conditions the expansion trajectories appear to violate simple rules based on the second law of thermodynamics that were previously established for ideal or weakly dissipative fluids.

arxiv-2302-04156.title: Prompting for Multimodal Hateful Meme Classification
arxiv-2302-04156.creator: Rui Cao, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Wen-Haw Chong, Jing Jiang
arxiv-2302-04156.description: Abstract Hateful meme classification is a challenging multimodal task that requires complex reasoning and contextual background knowledge. Ideally, we could leverage an explicit external knowledge base to supplement contextual and cultural information in hateful memes. However, there is no known explicit external knowledge base that could provide such hate speech contextual information.

arxiv-2405-00383.title: Learning Tactile Insertion in the Real World
arxiv-2405-00383.creator: Daniel Palenicek, Theo Gruner, Tim Schneider, Alina Böhm, Janis Lenz, Inga Pfenning, Eric Krämer, Jan Peters
arxiv-2405-00383.description: Abstract Humans have exceptional tactile sensing capabilities, which they can leverage to solve challenging, partially observable tasks that cannot be solved from visual observation alone. Research in tactile sensing attempts to unlock this new input modality for robots. Lately, these sensors have become cheaper and, thus, widely available.

arxiv-2406-01556.title: Observations and detectability of young Suns’ flaring and CME activity in optical spectra 2015 Observations and detectability of young Suns’ flaring and CME activity in optical spectra – 12
arxiv-2406-01556.creator: M. Leitzinger, P. Odert, R. Greimel
arxiv-2406-01556.description: Abstract The Sun’s history is still a subject of interest to modern astrophysics. Observationally constrained CME rates of young solar analogues are still lacking, as those require dedicated monitoring. We present medium resolution optical spectroscopic monitoring of a small sample of bright and prominent solar analogues over a period of three years using the 0.

arxiv-2510-14068.title: On the expressivity of sparse maxout networks
arxiv-2510-14068.creator: Moritz Grillo Max Planck Institute for Mathematics in the Sciences moritz.grillo@mis.mpg.de Tobias Hofmann TU Berlin tobias.hfm@icloud.com
arxiv-2510-14068.description: Abstract Abstract. We study the expressivity of sparse maxout networks, where each neuron takes a fixed number of inputs from the previous layer and employs a, possibly multi-argument, maxout activation. This setting captures key characteristics of convolutional or graph neural networks.

plos-pone-0002775.description: PLOS ONE research article. plos-pone-0005613.title: High Human Herpesvirus 8 (HHV-8) Prevalence, Clinical Correlates and High Incidence among Recently HIV-1-Infected Subjects in Sao Paulo, Brazil
plos-pone-0005613.creator: Mariana Dias Batista, Suzete Ferreira, Mariana M. Sauer et al.
plos-pone-0005613.description: PLOS ONE research article. Human herpesvirus 8 (HHV-8) is the etiological agent for Kaposi Sarcoma, which occurs especially in HIV-infected subjects. HHV-8 infection and its clinical correlates have not been well characterized in recently HIV-1-infected subjects, especially men who have sex with men (MSM).

pmc-10741047.title: Leukocyte- and Platelet-Rich Fibrin (L-PRF) Obtained from Smokers and Nonsmokers Shows a Similar Uniaxial Tensile Response In Vitro
pmc-10741047.creator: Cesar Lara, Alejandro Bezmalinovic, Claudio García-Herrera, Susana Ríos, Loreto M Valenzuela, Constanza E Martínez, Stefano Bellosta
pmc-10741047.description: We evaluated and compared the biomechanical properties of Leukocyte-and Platelet Rich Fibrin L-PRF clots and membranes derived from smoker and nonsmoker donors. Twenty venous-blood donors (aged 18 to 50 years) were included after signing informed consent forms. L-PRF clots were analyzed and then compressed to obtain L-PRF membranes.

pmc-11313089.title: A Two-Layer Graphene Nonwoven Fabric for Effective Electromagnetic Interference Shielding
pmc-11313089.creator: Ying Wu, Haijun Tang, Liying Kang, Hongfu Li, Naisheng Jiang
pmc-11313089.description: Rapid advancements and proliferation of electronic devices in the past decades have significantly intensified electromagnetic interference (EMI) issues, driving the demand for more effective shielding materials. Herein, we introduce a novel two-layer graphene nonwoven fabric (2-gNWF) that shows excellent EMI shielding properties.

pmc-12495391.title: A tissue-engineered endothelial cell – smooth muscle cell arteriole-like model
pmc-12495391.creator: Ninghao Zhu, Lily Liang, Nan Zhao, Haosong Chen, Peter C. Searson
pmc-12495391.description: Arterioles are small arteries that play a pivotal role in regulating blood flow and pressure. Co-culture of smooth muscle cells (SMCs) and endothelial cells (ECs) in a collagen fiber matrix with the correct spatial organization has been challenging. Here, we report a 3D tissue-engineered arteriole model (∼150 μm in diameter) with co-cultured confluent monolayers of SMCs and ECs.

pmc-12608027.title: Long Non-Coding RNAs in the Cold-Stress Response of Horticultural Plants: Molecular Mechanisms and Potential Applications
pmc-12608027.creator: Magdalena Wielogórska, Anna Rucińska, Yuliya Kloc, Maja Boczkowska, Andrew Eamens
pmc-12608027.description: Cold stress reduces horticultural crop yield and postharvest quality by disrupting membrane fluidity, redox equilibrium, and the cell wall structure. This results in chilling injury, tissue softening, and loss of color. Long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) have emerged as key integrators of plant cold signaling pathways.

pmc-12690866.title: Expression of melatonin receptors in trigeminal and sphenopalatine ganglia: potential targets for primary headache disorders
pmc-12690866.creator: Aida Maddahi, Jacob C A Edvinsson, Lars Edvinsson, Diana N Krause
pmc-12690866.description: BackgroundPrimary headache disorders such as migraine and cluster headache exhibit circadian and circannual variations in attack onset. Melatonin plays a central role in regulating biological rhythms and likely influences the timing of headache attacks. Recent evidence suggests melatonin may be a promising treatment for migraine and cluster headache; however, underlying mechanisms need to be elucidated.

pmc-13072731.title: Single-Cell and Spatial Transcriptomics Reveal That TXNIP and BIRC3 Contribute to Human Prostate Tumor Progression
pmc-13072731.creator: Seyed Taleb Hosseini, Hossein Azizi, Thomas Skutella
pmc-13072731.description: Prostate cancer is one of the most prevalent malignancies among men and remains a major clinical challenge due to the complex tumor microenvironment. Understanding gene expression dynamics at both cellular and spatial levels is essential for improving therapeutic strategies. In this study, we performed an integrated multi-omics analysis using single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics.

pmc-13381376.title: Intravenous versus oral tranexamic acid in shoulder arthroplasty
pmc-13381376.creator: Tarishi Parmar, Akin Adio, Mohammad Daher, Adam Khan, John Horneff, Joseph Abboud
pmc-13381376.description: PurposeTranexamic acid (TXA) is used in shoulder arthroplasty to reduce blood loss. While intravenous (IV) TXA is standard, oral TXA offers advantages in cost and administration. This study compares 90-day complications and postoperative laboratory values between IV and oral TXA in total shoulder arthroplasty (TSA).

pmc-13386162.title: Editorial: Stress-induced psychopathology: from mechanisms to interventions
pmc-13386162.creator: Anson Kai Chun Chau, Guangzhe Frank Yuan, Hong Wang Fung
pmc-13386162.description: serve as triggers for symptom onset and exacerbation across a range of psychopathologies, including depression, anxiety, schizophrenia, and trauma-related conditions such as dissociative disorders and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Stressful events and exposures range from DSM/ICD-defined PTSD trauma (e.g., Criterion A events such as assault or disasters) to subtler forms of adversities such as social exclusion, discrimination and neglect.
